load.description: The kernel's load of the kind, when a module reads it from the bus.

log.description: The log that holds its records.

module.description: The capability that checks a write.

pointers.description: The pointers it heads (`*` ends a prefix).

post.description: Its own write route, answered by its log's receive op.

receive.description: The capability whose `receive` op writes the kind's log (D-228).

records.description: The log's record kinds of its collection.

references.description:
The fields that name other records or things, each with its
target, from the current version's schema (`x-references`, D-232).

route.description: Where it is written, in words a person reads in a refusal.

store_kind.description: The envelope's kind, or a log's document kind.

tag.description:
The tag the document carries inside it, which names its schema.
Empty for a kind with no schema of ours (a GTFS zip, a file of a
build).

validate.description: Its op that checks a write.

versions.description: The versions with a schema in this build.

LoadEntry.description: A kind's kernel load: its JSON op and its bulk op's code.

Merge.description: How two writes of a kind meet.

oneOf.description: The whole document, by CAS on the head the writer read.
Last writer wins for each record id (the edit document; D-56).
Ops over the log's head; different records never conflict.

PostEntry.description:
A kind's own write route: the path, the op the request's body is the
arguments of, the answer's field that names the document after the
write, and the body's fields the answer repeats.

oneOf.description: Never served by hash. A client reads only its own projection.
A caller with the audit rule (a log's entries name their writers).

RecordEntry.description: One record kind of a log, and where it lives in its document.

collection.description:
The document field that holds the collection: an array of records
with an `id`, or an object by id.

kind.description: The record's kind in a log entry's changes.

Reference.description:
One declared reference: where it is in a document, and its target.

The path is a JSON Pointer with two additions. `*` is each item of an
array, or each value of an object keyed by id. `[tag=value]` after a
segment chooses the branch of a tagged enum, by the value of its tag
field (`/notes/*/target[kind=edit]/id`). A declaration on an array
applies to each item, so its path ends in `*`.

VersionEntry.description: One version of a kind, and its schema.

schema.description:
The schema's content hash (the store keeps it as
`schemas/<tag>.v<N>/<hex>.json`).

oneOf.description:
`POST /pointers/<name>`, one of `pointers`, checked by `module`'s
`validate` op, and stored as the module answers it.
Its own route (`route`), which runs its module.
The server alone: an import, a release, or the manifest.

description: The kind table of one build.

kinds.description: Each kind the store keeps, by its store kind.

title: KindTable
